name: Discord Mod (Vencord + Serpantinum)
description: Adaptive Material You, floating island architecture, and liquid glass styling for Discord via Vencord.
author: PageNguyen
installed_check: [ -f "$SERPANTINUM_DIR/src/scripts/discord_sync.sh" ] && grep -q 'outline_variant' "$SERPANTINUM_DIR/src/quickshell/singletons/theme/Matugen.qml" && grep -q 'let savedTheme' "$SERPANTINUM_DIR/src/quickshell/singletons/theme/Matugen.qml" && grep -q 'onLoaded ignores file changes' "$SERPANTINUM_DIR/src/quickshell/singletons/system/Config.qml" && grep -q 'Re-render the Discord theme immediately' "$SERPANTINUM_DIR/src/quickshell/guide/theme/ThemeTabState.qml"
